name: Historic and Architectural Complex of the Kazan Kremlin
description: The Kazan Kremlin is a hilltop fortress above the Kazanka River in Kazan, the capital of Tatarstan. It is the only surviving Tatar fortress in Russia. Ivan the Terrible captured it in 1552, and its white walls now enclose buildings from the 16th to 19th centuries, built over remains of much older structures. Together they reflect both Muslim Tatar and Orthodox Christian history.
